chants.vernacular_text: Behold, God is my helper, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul; turn back all the evil against my enemies, destroy them in your fidelity, O Lord, the Protector of my life. ℣. Save me, O God, by your name, and render justice unto me in your strength.
O Lord, our governor, how admirable is your name in all the earth! ℣. For your magnificence is elevated above the heavens.
Though I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me, O Lord. ℣. Your rod and your staff have comforted me.
Deliver me from my enemies, O my God, and defend me from those who have risen up against me.
The ordinances of the Lord are right, bringing joy to all hearts, sweeter than honey or the honeycomb. Therefore your servant will observe them.
You will accept a sacrifice of righteousness, oblations and burnt offerings, placed on your altar, O Lord.
Mary has chosen for herself the best portion, which shall never be taken away from her.
